message: "users"."id2" is added as an identity column, which rewrites the whole "users" table while blocking reads and writes.
why: The new value must be computed for every existing row, so PostgreSQL rewrites the table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. A constant default, or a stable one such as now(), does not need a rewrite.
safeAlternative: Add a plain nullable column, fill it in batches (for identity: attach a sequence as the default first), and switch the application to it. Avoid adding computed columns to large tables in place.
